Tedds includes the moment of the horizontal seismic column force (F_Ex × h = 3.0 kips × 15 in.) in the governing combination; the register gives HouseCalc the vertical loads only (HouseCalc pads take the post's vertical reaction; lateral column shear goes to a base-plate / pier check).

Not reconciled from the printed inputs: Tedds F_dz = 3.334 kips implies soil over 1.39 ft of the 1.6 ft width (wall printed as 8 in.); HouseCalc 2,015 psf with the soil over the projection beyond the wall. Tedds is 3.4 % higher (conservative).

Edition: the Tedds sheets use SDPWS-2015 (seismic ASD = v / 2.0 for gypsum). SDPWS-2021 Table 4.3C keeps the nominal gypsum values but sets the seismic ASD reduction to 2.8; HouseCalc applies 2021 — 2.0 / 2.8 = 0.714 × Tedds for gypsum-only walls, 0.75 × Tedds for WSP + gypsum sheathing where twice the gypsum value governs. Wind capacities are unchanged.

1/2 in. gypsum wallboard, unblocked, 4 in. edges: the Blackthorne Tedds sheets print v = 250 plf (the blocked cell); SDPWS Table 4.3C (as reproduced by WoodWorks) gives 220 plf unblocked. HouseCalc uses 220 plf (conservative).
